name: UQ Union emergency financial support payment
summary: One-off UQ Union payment for current UQ students whose financial stability is hit by extenuating circumstances.
who: Facing extenuating circumstances that affect your financial stability, with evidence of the hardship.
how: Book a Welfare appointment with a SAS advocate, who assesses you and gives you the form if you're eligible.
catches: No amount is published. A panel decides after assessment.
Separate from UQ's own hardship grant.

source.label: UQ Union: Student Advocacy and Support

evidence.quote: Students can apply for an emergency financial support payment for the purposes of obtaining a once-off payment
by booking a Welfare appointment with a SAS advocate.
